No firm date on the Gamma yet — the US batch is owed and I won't quote a date I can't stand behind. If you want something shipping in a few days, the Hammer BC04 is $239 for 6 TH/s, about three times the Gamma's hashrate.

Is it the small desktop size you're after, or just the cheapest way in?
when did it go out of stock

I don't have a date for when it sold out — that's not something I can see from here, and I won't guess.

What I can tell you: demand ran ahead of the incoming batch, so it's been backordered rather than restocked. If you want to be first when it lands, the product page has a notify option.

Want me to line up what's actually shippable now instead?
